patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I slipped on the wet floor and caught myself on my hand. Now my wrist is swollen and bent a bit funny, and it really hurts to move. My fingers are fine though.
clinical.presentationShort: 63yo F — FOOSH with dorsally-angulated (dinner-fork) wrist deformity, swelling, NV intact — distal radius fracture.
clinical.presentationLong: 63-year-old female, fell onto an outstretched hand with a dorsally angulated 'dinner-fork' wrist deformity and swelling, neurovascularly intact — distal radius (Colles) fracture.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → X-ray, reduction & splint, ortho follow-up; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Dinner-fork deformity after a FOOSH = Colles. Check NV, reduce, splint. (Also: why did she fall?)

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, cradling a deformed, swollen wrist
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 63-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: cradling a swollen, bent wrist against her body. Expression: pained but stoic. Clearly visible: a visibly deformed, swollen wrist. No text, no logos.
